name: Iron Blue Message
original_name: アイアンブルー・メッセージ
source:
No matter how nice the handwriting is, 
well, that's all I know, 
but I still want to feel something fateful. 

It's pretty romantic to be attracted to the handwriting and fall in love. 

This is a story about a part-time job with a clerk at the fountain pen shop.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/15258]Freem![/url]]
